investment_thesis.summary: Microsoft is a core quality holding with strong pricing power, recurring revenues and early monetisation of AI investments. The company converts large-scale capex into cash flow faster and with higher certainty than peers, fitting a leveraged portfolio strategy.

green: AI products (Copilot) contribute visibly to revenue growth
Operating margin remains stable despite elevated capex
red: Sustained margin compression without revenue acceleration
Regulatory actions materially impact core businesses

exit_logic: Trim on significant multiple expansion without earnings acceleration; exit only if long-term thesis around pricing power and monetisation breaks.
